title: Words to read and colour: Qalqalah
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y1 lesson 46 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words to read and colour)
intro: Lesson 46. Read each word slowly to a grown-up, then colour the part we learned today (Qalqalah). Then trace and copy.

panels.title: Five bouncing letters
points: Bounce only when they have sukoon

questions.a: lam yalid, with a small bounce on the last د

questions.q: Pupil PDF: read six words; colour the bouncing letter yellow. The teacher listens to today's group.
questions.a: Six words read; qalqalah letters with sukoon coloured.

questions.q: Extend: say the five letters to a grown-up: qutbu jad.
Which letter is a qalqalah letter?
questions.a: A) د. The five are ق ط ب ج د.

questions.q: Qalqalah letters bounce when they have ...
Think again: Some letters are so strong that when they are quiet they still give a little bounce. Which letters do you think they are?
questions.a: ق ط ب ج د: we remember them as qutbu jad (قطب جد).
